name: orca
description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
one_liner: A control panel that lets you manage a whole fleet of different AI coding assistants from one place, on your phone, desktop, or a remote server.
buyer: An engineering manager who wants visibility and control over several AI coding sessions running in parallel across their team.
business_use_cases: An engineering manager monitors and steers multiple AI agents working on different tickets across a sprint, from their phone during a commute.
A remote dev shop offers 'AI agent fleet management' as a billed service, running client work on managed agent fleets they oversee.
A non-technical founder kicks off and babysits coding tasks on their phone while away from a laptop, letting the agents run on remote compute.

money_ideas.idea: Charge a monthly fee for the hosted remote-runtime tier that lets agent fleets keep running without the user's own machine staying online.

steal_this: Set up a fleet of 3 coding agents on a real project this weekend and run the whole thing from your phone for a day to see if mobile-first agent management actually fits your workflow.
